definitions.explanation: Unpleasant or offensive to look at.

examples.japanese: 「{醜|みにく}いアヒルの{子|こ}」という{物語|ものがたり}を{知|し}っていますか。
examples.english: Do you know the story 'The Ugly Duckling'?

examples.japanese: {権力|けんりょく}をめぐる{醜|みにく}い{争|あらそ}いが{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: The ugly struggle for power continued.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{醜|みにく}い{姿|すがた}を{見|み}せたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to show my ugly side.

notes:
{醜|みにく}い is an i-adjective meaning ugly, both physically and morally.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {醜|みにく}く
- Noun form: {醜|みにく}さ (ugliness)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {醜|みにく}い{姿|すがた} (ugly appearance/form)
- {醜|みにく}い{争|あらそ}い (unseemly conflict)
- {醜|みにく}いアヒルの{子|こ} (The Ugly Duckling)

ANTONYMS:
- {美|うつく}しい: Beautiful
- {綺麗|きれい}: Beautiful, pretty

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {醜|みにく}い vs. ブサイク: {醜|みにく}い is the standard/literary term; ブサイク is slang/colloquial for "ugly" (appearance).
- {醜|みにく}い vs. {見苦|みぐる}しい: {見苦|みぐる}しい focuses more on being "unpleasant to watch" (behavior), while {醜|みにく}い covers both appearance and morality.

Register: Neutral to formal. A strong word that can be offensive when applied directly to people.
